description: Accumulation of dry combustible cardboard and packaging material near electrical junction box without fire retardant barrier.
existingControls: One outdated 2kg CO2 extinguisher 30 meters away.
mitigations: Install automatic ABC dry powder extinguishers, clear 3m buffer zone around electricals, daily end-of-shift clearance.

description: Cracked secondary containment trays for chemical reagent waste containers in chemistry prep room.
mitigations: Procure high-density polyethylene spill pallets, deploy chemical spill response kits, label all containers with hazard symbols.

description: Food waste, curry gravy and plastic disposable cutlery disposed into dry recycling bins, contaminating entire bin batches.
existingControls: Color coded bins installed near dining hall exit.
mitigations: Add dual-stream graphic signage at eye level, station student eco-monitors during peak lunch hours (12pm-2pm).

description: Weekend vendor collection skips resulting in overflowing central chutes and animal scavenging near hostel ground floor.
existingControls: Daily phone call to municipal collection agency.
mitigations: Implement digital vendor gate-in logging and automated SMS reminder trigger when pickup is unconfirmed by 11:00 AM.

description: Discarded lancets and syringe needles found in non-puncture-proof plastic bags.
existingControls: Color coded bins present in triage room.
mitigations: Issue certified yellow puncture-proof sharps boxes with needle-destroyer cutters; mandatory nurse training checklist.

hazard: Leachate leakage from organic composting yard
description: Monsoon runoff carrying high-BOD organic leachate into nearby stormwater drainage trench.
mitigations: Construct perimeter bund and redirect runoff to dedicated percolation pit with sawdust filter bed.
